en: Old monochrome postcard showing a wooded valley with dense trees surrounding a small pond or river. At the center is a wooden platform or pavilion on stilts extending over the water, possibly part of a watermill or viewing structure. Along the bottom margin there is printed text in Dutch/German mentioning a waterfall, hotel and a place called Plasmolen near Mook on the river Maas, with handwritten cursive notes over the margin.
